newsitem.title: USA: Apartment Investment buys Florida apartments.
newsitem.headline: Apartment Investment buys Florida apartments.

text.p: Apartment Investment and Management Co said Thursday it had reached an agreement to buy The Bay Club of Aventura, a luxury high-rise apartment community in Aventura, Fla., for $67.5 million.
The company said that the stabilized annual contribution to its Cash Earned for Shareholders - the company's measure of profitibality - is expected to be between $0.02 and $0.03 per share.

The purchase price for the 702 unit high-rise includes $0.5 million that it has budgeted for initial capital expenditures, the company said. It said it will assume an existing $49 million loan which bears interest at about eight percent per annum and matures in November 2001, and will pay cash for the balance of the purchase price.
The closing of the deal is expected during the second quarter.
